# Pinned upstream Typst packages

Unmodified Universe package archives, downloaded 2026-09-20 from
`https://packages.typst.org/preview/{name}-{version}.tar.gz`.

| Package | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| charged-ieee | 0.1.4 | MIT-0 | https://typst.app/universe/package/charged-ieee/ |
| starter-journal-article | 0.5.1 | MIT | https://typst.app/universe/package/starter-journal-article/ |
| oxifmt (starter dependency) | 0.2.1 | MIT-0 | https://typst.app/universe/package/oxifmt/ |

Original source, license, documentation and examples are retained. `--package-path`
points here; generation uses the pinned packages without downloading at runtime.
The application supplies existing manuscript content and chooses installed fonts.
No template source is rewritten. Test runtime: Typst CLI 0.15.1.
